description: This Java class 'ChewbaccaUtils' provides a utility method to gather and return system information about an Android device, including hardware details and configuration data.

classes.name: ChewbaccaUtils
classes.description: An abstract utility class that offers a static method to retrieve system information from an Android device.

methods.name: getSysInfo
methods.description: Returns a string containing detailed system information such as device model, build ID, version, and locale, formatted with line breaks.
